Changes.Development: Chapter 4 depicts the execution of the physical examination and blood work. During the procedure, Adrian suffered a medical crisis (shock) caused by the nanites' extreme metabolic acceleration. Dr. Chen diagnosed this as a strain on his system and extended his hospital stay for monitoring. Hospital administrator David Miller intervened, pressuring for resource efficiency while offering vague 'increased compensation' to retain Adrian as a trial participant. Adrian challenged the ambiguity of the financial offer, leading to a postponement of the compensation discussion until the next day. The genetic panel was scheduled for the following day.
